responsibility: This header defines the `cortexa53_tunings` model for Arm Cortex-A53 in the AArch64 backend. It provides the A53-specific register-move costs and the complete `tune_params` bundle—issue rate, fusible operations, alignment preferences, reassociation widths, generic vector behavior, and load/store-pair policy—that the backend consults for code generation heuristics when targeting or tuning for Cortex-A53.
